prompt: Create ONE transparent production illustration based on this accepted red panda character design, for the UPPER-RIGHT CORNER of a desktop app's message input card. The character is peeking diagonally UP AND LEFT from behind the card's top edge: the unseen body originates below and to the RIGHT, the cute round head leans outward towards the UPPER LEFT, its eyes look up-left into the open page, and two tiny dark paws rest near the BOTTOM of the illustration as though holding the card edge. Show the head, ears and small paws only; hide the body below the bottom boundary. Do NOT draw any card, ledge, wall, outline box or background: the app itself provides the edge. The silhouette must communicate a curious little peek and a playful tilted head, not a centred passport portrait. Preserve the reference's rust-orange fur, soft cream face mask and ear interiors, round ears, dark ink nose and gentle simple black eyes, the rounded cheek proportions and restrained dry hand-ink contour. Keep it endearing and calm, a tiny warm smile, no sly grin or angry brows. Flat hand-drawn animation shapes with simplified texture suitable for displaying at roughly 110px tall; no 3D, no shiny finish, no sparkle, no extra symbols, text, clothing or props. Square canvas, leave modest transparent padding, keep both ears entirely visible. The head should be displaced towards upper-left relative to the paws at lower-right so that it feels like it is leaning out of the corner. Truly transparent alpha outside the character, opaque cream areas inside the face and ears. No beige paper texture background, shadow, circular badge or watermark. Match the approved identity precisely.
